name: GOV extended: NewImplementation (Compound Unitroller / CErc20Delegator)
description: Compound Unitroller / CErc20Delegator: NewImplementation(address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
